sections.text:
Condensate Pump Multi 
 Stage, Vertical type

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every six months as indicated by 
M6 in above title block.

This pump is used to 
transfer condensate water from condenser hot well to dearators to feed pump of 
HRSG.

The first draft initiated 
by Eng. Mahmoud Abou El-Fetouh Shata, tested by eng. Ali Abd Elslam, revised by 
EDEPC quality control engineer Abouda El-bana, accepted by general director eng. 
Yosry Abd Elmaqsood, and approved by eng. Fathy Ragab head sector of Talkha 
Power Station.

تم قبول هذه الوثيقة من قبل المهندس.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
inspection and

 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial 
 inspection, quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.
